name: Before your annual physical
summary: What to bring, whether to fast and how to prepare.
body:
Fasting: only if your lab order says so. Water is fine.

Bring: photo ID, insurance card, a list of medicines, home readings.

Plan: arrive ten minutes early; the nurse takes vitals before you see the provider.

name: Lab draw preparation
summary: Fasting rules, water and how long the draw takes.
body: A draw takes about ten minutes. Fast for eight to twelve hours when told to. Take usual medicines with water unless your provider says otherwise.

name: After a sick visit
summary: Rest, fluids, when to call back and warning signs.
body: Follow the plan on your visit summary. Call the office if you are not improving in two to three days or if symptoms get worse. For emergencies, call 911.

name: After a vaccine
summary: What is normal, what to do and when to call.
body: A sore arm and mild tiredness are common for a day or two. Call if you have a rash, swelling of the face, or trouble breathing; for severe symptoms call 911.

name: Using the patient area
summary: Where to find visit summaries, lab results and handouts.
body: Sign in at the patient area. Visit summaries appear within two days. Lab results are posted when they arrive. This demo site holds no real health information.

name: Asking for a refill or referral
summary: Who to call and how long it takes.
body: Refills: allow two business days and ask your pharmacy to send the request. Referrals: call the front desk; most are ready within three business days.

name: Visit and cancellation policy
summary: How we handle late arrivals, cancellations and missed visits.
body: Please cancel at least one business day ahead so someone else can use the slot. If you are more than 15 minutes late we may offer a shorter visit or reschedule.

name: Front desk phone script
summary: Opening lines, the triage questions and when to hand off to a nurse.
body: 1. Greet and ask for name and date of birth. 2. Ask the reason in one sentence. 3. If any emergency sign, say: please hang up and call 911. 4. Otherwise route to the nurse queue.

name: Same-day slot rules
summary: Which visit types use held slots and how to release them.
body: Hold six same-day slots each morning. Release unfilled slots at 2:00 pm. Escalate children under 3 months with fever to the nurse at once.

name: Vaccine fridge check
body: Log the temperature at opening and closing. Out-of-range readings go to Joan Whitlock immediately. This checklist is an example for the demo.

name: Records request steps
summary: How a records request moves from the desk to release.
body: 1. Confirm identity at the desk. 2. Log the request. 3. Provider reviews. 4. Release by the patient's chosen method.
